name: Otter Yakuza
detailed_description:
Otter Yakuza is a manga-style action-puzzle adventure set in a gritty, modern Yokohama-inspired city teeming with gang turf wars, shady back alleys, and rooftop secrets.

You play as Zuka, the young and chaotic new boss of a fallen otter clan. With your family scattered and your turf overtaken by the unhinged Cobra Corp., it's time to reclaim your name, rebuild your empire, and teach the city who really owns the river.

From crate-smuggling street puzzles to rooftop onsen strategy, every mission challenges your crew’s skills, loyalty, and timing. Switch between three playable otters with unique personalities, build your hideout, and make choices that ripple across the underworld.

This is more than a game.
This is family.
This is business.
This is Otter Yakuza.

The river always remembers.

Features

  • 🦦 Three-otter crew system — swap between Otter Boss Zuka, muscle-bound Ooki, and genius DaGai, each with unique playstyles

  • 🧩 Innovative action-puzzle gameplay — every crate, code, and ambush counts

  • 🎴 Base building — customize your headquarters with an onsen, hitman agency, tattoo parlor, and more

  • 💥 Stylized black-and-white manga visuals — every frame looks like a page from a comic

  • 🐍 Rival gangs & enemies — including the chaotic, punk Gekkos and other underground threats

  • 🎭 Rich storytelling — filled with honor, betrayal, slapstick chaos, and Yakuza energy

  • 🎮 Controller-friendly and built for short, punchy sessions or deep story dives

Tagline

Otter Yakuza.
Otters. Crime. Honor. Chaos.

The river always remembers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
